item.subject: science
item.stem: Priya adds baking soda to water at 25 °C in a steel tumbler at home. Some baking soda settles at the bottom and does not dissolve. She then heats the mixture to 55 °C while stirring with a spoon. Which row correctly predicts what happens to the undissolved baking soda and to the amount of baking soda that can dissolve at the higher temperature?

options.A: undissolved baking soda remains at the bottom; the amount that can dissolve stays the same
options.B: undissolved baking soda dissolves; more baking soda can dissolve at the higher temperature
options.C: undissolved baking soda dissolves; less baking soda can dissolve at the higher temperature
options.D: undissolved baking soda remains at the bottom; the amount that can dissolve decreases
